note: Legal Freelance pipeline scrape, 7-day window (Jul 27 - Aug 3, 2026). Web-search-only sourcing (no LinkedIn bot scraping; LinkedIn postings referenced via Google/Bing-indexed results only). Deduplicated against legal-freelance reports 07-10 through 07-31 and pr-freelance reports — already-captured buyers/benches excluded (Axiom, Priori, Epiq Counsel, Outside GC, Paragon, Tower Legal, Broughton, aVenture, Latitude, Legal.io/Roasa, Allocate, Major Lindsey & Africa, Robert Half, Lawtrades, Peerpoint, Elevate/ElevateFlex, Continuum, Uncommon Counsel, Lawyers on Demand, SylloTips, Arootah, Bowery Legal, Water Quality Association, etc.). Indigo Technologies (fractional GC) was reviewed and EXCLUDED — role already filled. Only leads scoring 55+ included. Quality over quantity: 6 solid fractional/interim/contract counsel opportunities matching Katie's high-judgment corporate/fund counsel ICP. This run skews corporate/GC and consultant-bench; no new clean fund-formation postings surfaced that weren't already captured, so no Grade-A leads this cycle.
